name: Database views
description: A block that lists the files matching a query (a folder, a type, tags, their properties) as a table, cards, a list, a board, a calendar or a map, sorted and grouped, like a database; and Obsidian's .base files, embeds and ```base fences on the same engine. Click a row to open it, double-click a value to change it.

query.description: the files that match a query, as a table, cards, a list, a board, a calendar or a map, with formulas and column summaries

from.description: the folders to look in (path prefixes)

type.description: the files' type, or a list of them (any)

tags.description: tags the files must all have (a nested one counts for its parent)

where.description: an expression over the keys (relation = friend and every_days <= 30), or a map of key: value

filters.description: a Bases filter: an expression (file.hasTag("book") && status != "done"), or and / or / not lists of them

formulas.description: computed columns, name: a Bases expression (formula.<name> in columns, sort, group)

columns.description: the columns: frontmatter keys, and file, folder, path, updated, created; the name and the keys most matches have when left out

properties.description: column labels, the Bases way: key: {displayName: Label}

summaries.description: a summary under a column, key: Sum, Average, Min, Max, Median, Range, Count... or an expression over values

sort.description: the keys to sort by, in turn; a leading - sorts descending (or Bases' {property, direction}); by file when left out

group.description: the key rows are grouped by (a board's columns), or Bases' {property, direction}

groups.description: the groups in this order, the rest after; a board shows them even when empty

limit.description: at most this many rows (50 when left out, a calendar's or a map's 500)

date.description: a calendar's date key (date when the files have one, else created)

month.description: the month a calendar shows, as YYYY-MM (this one when left out)

coordinates.description: a map's key for where each file is ([lat, lon] or "lat, lon"; coordinates when left out)

markerColor.description: a map's key for a pin's colour (an app colour's name, or a CSS colour)

markerIcon.description: a map's key for a pin's icon (a lucide name)

archived.description: true lists archived files too, only lists only them
